# Persona Generator

> Unreleased v0.2 candidate for configuring one fictional agent's desired behavior through an exact human-confirmed core spec and deterministic approved-only effective projection.

Experimental discovery file; crawler support is not guaranteed. Read only the smallest task-specific path.

## Limits

Only op.planning_structure.v1 and op.advisory_initiative.v1 are supported operational analogues; neither is behaviorally tested. Ten human aspects are vocabulary, not ten implemented traits. Other aspects remain unspecified. New core behavior and authentic owner E2E NOT RUN. Trace is inert; only approved catalog rules may render. Edits require reconfirmation and reload verifies the exact confirmed artifact. Static validation does not prove consent or model behavior.

Multiple personas, panel synthesis and Persona Pack are optional legacy paths only when explicitly requested. Historical mappings, evidence and validators do not transfer to the new core. No real-person profiling, diagnosis, psychometric scoring, sensitive inference, high-stakes use or autonomous final decision. Human final judgment; stop when the bounded task is complete. No static persona catalog or standalone website requirement.
